dedupe_keys.name: open data for manuscript benchmarking reservoir release policies across conus roles of model structure calibration and reservoir characteristics

description: Alejandro Sánchez-Gómez publishes a benchmark of reservoir release policies across the contiguous United States. Zenodo provides one public archive under CC BY 4.0 and points to an actively maintained GitHub repository. The description names six policies spanning generic, data-driven and optimisation methods, applied to 250 reservoirs under a common simulation and calibration workflow. Code for processing, reservoir simulation, evaluation and figures is included along with processed input data, performance measures and the best-performing simulation for each reservoir. Modellers can compare operating policies or calibrate reservoir-routing components. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this benchmark. Coverage is a selected 250-reservoir set, not every US dam. A limitation is that performance rankings depend on calibration choices and available inflow records; a manuscript title does not establish peer-reviewed acceptance. The archive was not opened, the GitHub code was not executed, and best-policy claims were not independently reproduced.
